articles.title: Data Breach at La Poste Subsidiary Maileva Affects 22 Million People in France
articles.description: A cyberattack on La Poste subsidiary Maileva exposed the names and postal addresses of 22 million people, including patients and tenants. Maileva, a subsidiary of the La Poste group, was hit in mid-September in one of the biggest cyberattacks France has seen.…
